general_information.Description: The course is designed to familiarize students with translation and interpretation in tourism. The course focuses on (1) interlingual translation of different types of tourism documents and (2) the interpreting practice of tourism. During the course, the lesson may be conducted in various forms including documents, news, traditional lectures, exhibitions, tours, field trips... After taking this course, students should be able to: - Demonstrate a clear understanding terms used in tourism - Clearly understand different types and formats of texts used in tourism - Demonstrate a clear understanding of different types and settings of tourism interpretation - Translate and interpret and news and documents in tourism from Vietnamese into English and vice-versa
general_information.StudentTasks: Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination Actively participate in class activities Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class Use their own laptops in class only for learning purposes Read the theory in advance

description: The course is designed to familiarize students with translation and interpretation in tourism. The course focuses on (1) interlingual translation of different types of tourism documents and (2) the interpreting practice of tourism. During the course, the lesson may be conducted in various forms including documents, news, traditional lectures, exhibitions, tours, field trips... After taking this course, students should be able to: - Demonstrate a clear understanding terms used in tourism - Clearly understand different types and formats of texts used in tourism - Demonstrate a clear understanding of different types and settings of tourism interpretation - Translate and interpret and news and documents in tourism from Vietnamese into English and vice-versa

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify key concepts and terminology used in tourism translation and interpretation
Explain the cultural nuances and their impact on translation and interpretation within the tourism industry
Apply appropriate translation techniques to effectively convert tourism-related texts from the source language to the target language
Interpret oral communications accurately in tourism contexts, ensuring clarity and cultural sensitivity
Evaluate the quality of translated and interpreted texts, identifying areas for improvement
Create culturally appropriate and accurate translations of promotional materials for the tourism industry
Demonstrate an awareness of and respect for cultural diversity in translation and interpretation task
Display professionalism and ethical behavior in translation and interpretation practices, particularly in tourism contexts
Commit to continuous learning and improvement in the field of tourism translation and interpretation
